blocks.text: This page tracks the South Surrey and White Rock MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $990,300 for a typical home, down 7.3% over twelve months.
South Surrey and White Rock benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical South Surrey and White Rock home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $990,300 in September 2026. That is down 2.0% on the month, down 4.4% over three months, down 5.3% over six months and down 7.3% over the year. Over three years it is down 21.4%, and over five years down 10.5%.
The weakest one-year move in South Surrey and White Rock was for a townhouse homes at −11.2%; the strongest was a detached home at −7.4%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,612,500) and an apartment ($544,400) is $1,068,100, and a townhouse ($797,100) sits $252,700 above the apartment benchmark.

Against the Fraser Valley Board area, where the all-home benchmark was $861,300, South Surrey and White Rock is 15.0% above. Over the year the Fraser Valley Board area moved down 7.2% against down 7.3% here.
Of the 8 areas this board reports, South Surrey and White Rock ranks 2 by all-home benchmark, with North Delta above it at $1,011,500 and Langley below it at $941,800.

Detached homes in South Surrey and White Rock: benchmark $1,612,500, down 2.2% in a month, down 4.9% in three months, down 6.2% in six months, down 7.4% in a year, down 17.9% in three years and down 5.3% in five. That is 24.0% above the detached benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($1,300,000).

Townhouse homes in South Surrey and White Rock: benchmark $797,100, down 2.8% in a month, down 6.6% in three months, down 8.2% in six months, down 11.2% in a year, down 19.8% in three years and down 5.6% in five. That is 7.0% above the townhouse benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($745,300).

Apartment homes in South Surrey and White Rock: benchmark $544,400, down 1.2% in a month, down 2.9% in three months, down 4.7% in six months, down 7.7% in a year, down 12.5% in three years and up 3.3% in five. That is 17.9% above the apartment benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($461,800).

blocks.text: What the South Surrey and White Rock figure is
The $990,300 South Surrey and White Rock figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Fraser Valley Real Estate Board for September 2026.
